input: # JSON text. The default reader is jsonic with the yaml grammar; strict
# is the json grammar alone, and also requires a known version. Both
# give the same tree for JSON text.
# What strict refuses: a trailing comma, and anything that is not JSON.
# A JSON text whose first line is empty. The fast path reads it; the
# yaml grammar refuses it, a defect of the published yaml grammar that
# this row pins so that its repair shows here.
